messages.subject: Project Lyra — upfront payment authorisation
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — confirming Hartwell will pay the £6,000,000 upfront fee to Calderbrook on 13 February per clause 3.1. Can you confirm Calderbrook's account details from Birchall Stone and that the deal-economics / funds-flow figures we have are final? Want to make sure the legal and patent-recordal disbursements are captured too.

Gregory
